# `hk agent mcp`

- **Usage:** `hk agent mcp <--target <TARGET>>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print an MCP server configuration

## Flags

- **`--target <TARGET>`** — MCP host to generate the server configuration for

  **Choices:** `codex`, `claude-desktop`, `claude-code`, `vscode`

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Print an MCP configuration for your host, then review its project path.

```sh
hk agent mcp --target codex
hk agent mcp --target claude-desktop
```
